record.dic_text:
024 'abiyb {a:-vi:v'}

字根已不使用 (意為"變柔軟"); TWOT - 1b; 陽性名詞

欽定本 - Abib 6, in the ear 1, green ears of corn 1; 8

1) 初熟清嫩的大麥穀穗
2) 穀穗形成的月份, 未熟的穀物的月份, 或亞筆月, 出埃及逾越節的月份 (三或四月)
record.edic_text:
024 'abiyb {aw-beeb'}

from an unused root (meaning to be tender); TWOT - 1b; n m

AV - Abib 6, in the ear 1, green ears of corn 1; 8

1) fresh, young barley ears, barley
2) month of ear-forming, of greening of crop, of growing green
   Abib, month of exodus and passover (March or April)
